manifest.name: AfterClip
manifest.author: AfterClip
manifest.description: AfterClip-compatible shader effects and group presets, normalized for Zoidium.

effects.name: Circle Dot Wave
effects.description: Draws a circular dot-wave pattern.

effects.name: Dot Wave
effects.description: Draws an animated dot-wave pattern.

effects.name: Duplicate (Extended)
effects.description: Duplicates the source with extended repeat modes.

effects.name: Gradient Linear Repeat
effects.description: Repeats the source through a color gradient.

effects.name: Hex Dot Wave
effects.description: Draws a hexagonal dot-wave pattern.

effects.name: Linear Repeat
effects.description: Repeats the source along a linear path.

effects.name: Radial Repeat
effects.description: Repeats the source around a radial path.

effects.name: Stroke (Extended)
effects.description: Draws an extended alpha stroke around the source.

effects.name: Arrow Shape
effects.description: Draws a controllable arrow-shaped overlay.

effects.name: Chevron
effects.description: Draws a controllable chevron pattern.

effects.name: CLE
effects.description: Draws repeated circular line segments.

effects.name: Gradient (Easeable)
effects.description: Fills the source with an easeable color gradient.

effects.name: Hex Net
effects.description: Draws a hexagonal net overlay.

effects.name: Line Wave Mask
effects.description: Reveals the source with an animated line wave.

effects.name: Line Wave
effects.description: Draws animated line-wave colors over the source.

effects.name: Lines
effects.description: Draws a repeated diagonal line pattern.

effects.name: Net
effects.description: Draws a repeated two-direction line net.

effects.name: PinWheel
effects.description: Draws repeated pinwheel sectors.

effects.name: Plain Wave Mask
effects.description: Reveals the source with a plain wave.

effects.name: Plain Wave
effects.description: Draws a plain animated wave over the source.

effects.name: Polygon Echo
effects.description: Draws repeated polygon rings with stripes.

effects.name: Polygon
effects.description: Draws a polygon ring overlay.

effects.name: Repeating Dots
effects.description: Draws a row of repeating dots.

effects.name: RoundedStar
effects.description: RoundedStar from AfterClip.

effects.name: Shockwave
effects.description: Draws a polygonal shockwave ring.

effects.name: Triangle
effects.description: Draws a triangle overlay.

effects.name: Fractal Noise
effects.description: Generates fractal noise patterns.

effects.name: Fractal Warp
effects.description: Warps the source using fractal noise.

effects.name: Mirror (Fixed)
effects.description: Reflects the source with the corrected mirror behavior.

effects.name: Polar Coordinates
effects.description: Converts the source to polar coordinates.

effects.name: Stretch
effects.description: Stretches the source along a controlled angle.

effects.name: Wavy (Extended)
effects.description: Applies the extended animated wave distortion.
